checks.criterion: Seeded Watch Together profiles are renamed to Puja and Rishi
checks.name: couple-flow-shows-puja-rishi-names
checks.evidence: On members step, participant-aditi card shows 'Puja' with chips Sci-Fi/Thriller/Mystery and does NOT contain 'Aditi'; participant-rahul card shows 'Rishi' with Comedy/Romance/Sci-Fi and does NOT contain 'Rahul'.

checks.criterion: Chill & Learn offers multiple teacher quick-start topics beyond Climate Change; each quick-start updates the teaching objective; Climate Change preserves WALL-E 94%; additional topics return relevant varied content
checks.name: chill-learn-topic-rename-and-quickstarts
checks.evidence: learning-topic-options showed selectable quick starts. Default Climate Change -> learning-top-pick-title='WALL-E', learning-match-badge='94% Learning Match'. Selecting Space Science, History & Civil Rights, Media Literacy, Ethics each updated learning-topic-input to the respective label, pre-filled a non-empty learning-objective-input, and after Find Content returned top picks Hidden Figures, Hidden Figures, Explained, The Good Place respectively -- matching spec exactly.

checks.criterion: Teachers can move between setup and results repeatedly; Edit goal returns to visible topic controls without fixed navigation obscuring the control, even after scrolling
checks.name: chill-learn-edit-goal-not-obscured-after-scroll
checks.evidence: Scrolled setup form (wheel 800px), selected 90 minutes duration, clicked find-learning-content (no force) -> learning-results-heading visible. Scrolled results (wheel 600px) then clicked edit-learning-goal WITHOUT force -> click succeeded (not intercepted by fixed nav) and learning-topic-options became visible again.

checks.name: chill-learn-freetext-topic-works
checks.evidence: Typed 'tscheck-Ocean Conservation' into learning-topic-input (not a quick-start), kept default objective, clicked find-learning-content -> learning-results-heading visible, learning-top-pick-title non-empty, learning-match-badge visible, confirming a ranked non-empty recommendation.

checks.criterion: Existing seeded-profile Watch Together remains available (regression)
checks.name: couple-flow-seeded-profiles
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check from prior iteration: Couple flow proceeds from members step to preferences step successfully with renamed profiles.

checks.criterion: Regression: Custom Watch Together builder unaffected by rename/quick-start changes
checks.name: custom-recommendation-shows-names
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check; had to update its own script (not app code) because an unrelated app fix trimmed the mood testid from 'mood--funny' to 'mood-funny' (double-dash whitespace bug noted in iteration_1 is now fixed). After updating the check's selector, group-picks-heading rendered and subtitle contained both custom participant names 'tscheck-Alex' and 'tscheck-Sam'.

checks.criterion: Regression: Custom explainability modal unaffected by rename/quick-start changes
checks.name: custom-explainability-shows-member-matches
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check with same mood-testid selector fix applied. why-modal showed 2 why-member-custom-* cards with '% match' text and participant names, confirming explainability still works.
